criteria.reason: Copy Last, Next (for weight), and Done appear together in the keyboard actions row.
Done uses flex sizing in the three-button row instead of full width.
The buttons’ vertical padding and text height provide approximately 44px or more of touch height.
Copy Last updates the keypad value prop, but NumericKeypad’s displayed value is held in local state and does not sync to that prop.
Next changes the target field and value, but the keypad display also does not sync, so the visible keypad does not advance to reps.
Most colors and the border radius use design tokens, but the buttons still use hardcoded color values.
The actions use a flexible row, but no mobile-specific behavior is shown to verify the layout below 768px.
Button labels are plain and contain no exclamation marks or hype.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests passing.
The diff adds no test for Copy Last logic.
